dependencyChain: literal higher symmetric-power continuation -> automorphy -> eventual original residual large image -> exclusion of the A4, S4 and A5 projective alternatives
reuse: The pinned native Dickson classification already supplies the actual projective-image subgroup and equivalences. Mathlib supplies alternating/permutation cardinalities, Lagrange exponent bounds and quotient-center/scalar comparison. Native original characteristic polynomials and literal coefficient reduction remain the arithmetic consumers.
chosenFirstStep: Derive exponent dividing 120 for the three exceptional alternatives, then scalar 120th powers of the same original embedded residual matrices. Use these in a universal Frobenius trace/determinant polynomial relation.
shorterRouteAssessment: A fixed trace/determinant polynomial relation, together with one nonzero good Fourier coefficient and odd weight exponent at an unramified coefficient-field prime, may exclude all sufficiently large residual characteristics without p-adic Hodge foundations. The polynomial, valuation-parity and finite norm-divisor bridges are still to be proved; this is a route assessment, not an exclusion theorem.
deferred: No general p-adic Hodge theory or classification of all finite-order ratios is started. Cyclic, dihedral and elementary-abelian-by-cyclic alternatives remain separate.
status: New scratch proof attempt. No production change and no gate closure.
